{{Quote|Crusaders often carried a ''kal''—a dagger made of ''beskar''—in their off hand.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="TBHC" />}}
A '''''kal''''' was a traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Knife/Legends|dagger]]. Forged of [[Beskar/Legends|''beskar'']] [[Iron/Legends|iron]], [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] were known to wield a ''kal'' into battle in their off [[Limb/Legends|hand]], often in addition to another weapon. Most often, the kal was wielded alongside a ''[[Beskad/Legends|beskad]]'', the traditional Mandalorian [[Sword/Legends|saber]].<ref name="TBHC" />

The prevalence with which ''kale'' were used by the ancient Mandalorians led to [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] pieces worn on a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier's]] left side to be referred to as the ''kal'' plates, counter to the right plates which were referred to as the ''[[Beskad/Legends|beskad]]'' plates.<ref name="TBHC" />

In his [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] manifesto, ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', the splinter-sect's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]] [[Tor Vizsla]] describes the ''kal'', its history and use, and provides an illustration of the ''beskar'' dagger for the reader.<ref name="TBHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''kal'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]-centric reference guide co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Ryder Windham]], published [[October 15]], [[2013]].
